Name: Fantasy Wizard Seasonal Sprite Overhaul
Author: boringvlln
Description:
[color=#9900ff][size=4][b]Big hairy wizard for all your wizarding needs.
[/b][/size][/color]
This is a sprite replacer for good ol' Rasmodius. Features a bigger belly, well-kept hair, and a full beard.

Built upon [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]'s Slightly Cuter sprites. Seasonal variations and support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] included.


[size=3]2 (4) options to choose from:
[/size]
[b]Default[/b], human with seasonal jewelry. Made to fit portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url].

[b]Elf[/b] (ears) with [b]gold[/b] jewelry throughout the year. Made to fit portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11615]Seasonal Wizard Portraits- SVE and Vanilla[/url].

Additionally, there are human with gold jewelry and elf with seasonal jewelry sprite variants. Don't know if any portraits fit those exactly, but hey, why not.


Let me know which other portraits fit well with these sprites. Enjoy your wizards!
